hints: Use the right-angled triangle formed by the radius and perpendicular bisector of the chord: $\sin(\theta/2) = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4}$.
walkthrough:
In the isosceles $\triangle POQ$ with $OP = OQ = 4\text{ cm}$ and chord $PQ = 4\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}$, the perpendicular from $O$ bisects the chord and angle $\theta$:
$$\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right) = \frac{\frac{1}{2}(4\sqrt{3})}{4} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$

skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: The major segment $PXQ$ area equals the major sector area plus the area of $\triangle POQ$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of the major circular sector subtending angle $2\pi - \frac{2\pi}{3} = \frac{4\pi}{3}\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Area of major sector} = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \left(2\pi - \theta\right) = \frac{1}{2}(4^2)\left(\frac{4\pi}{3}\right) = 8\left(\frac{4\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{32\pi}{3}$$

Calculate the area of $\triangle POQ$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle POQ) = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}(4^2)\sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 8\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = 4\sqrt{3}$$

Sum the major sector area and the triangle area to find the exact area of segment $PXQ$:
$$\text{Area}(PXQ) = \frac{32\pi}{3} + 4\sqrt{3}$$

ai_rubric.Major Segment Area: Calculates major sector area $\frac{32\pi}{3}$ (M1), calculates triangle area $4\sqrt{3}$ (M1), and finds total exact area $\frac{32\pi}{3} + 4\sqrt{3}$ (A1).
